verses.en: Then said Solomon, The LORD hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.sm: Atua Ona faapea atu lea o Solomona, Na fetalai mai le ALII, e afio o ia i le pogisa.

verses.en: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.
verses.sm: A ua ou faia le fale mo oe e te afio ai, o le afioaga e te afio ai e faavavau.

verses.en: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.
verses.sm: Ona liliu atu lea o le tupu, ma faamanuia atu i le faapotopotoga uma o Isaraelu; ua tutu mai foi le faapotopotoga uma o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,
verses.sm: Ua ia faapea atu, la faafetaia le ALI le Atua o Isaraelu, o le ua faataunuuina mai i lona aao le mea na túlei mai lona fofoga i loʻu tama o Tavita, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:
verses.sm: Talu lava le aso na ou au mai ai o loʻu nuu nai le nuu o Aikupito, ou te lei filifilia se aai i itu aiga uma o Isaraelu e fai ai se fale ina ia i ai loʻu igoa; ou te lei filifilia foi se tasi e fai ma ta‘ita‘i o loʻu nuu o Isaraelu;

verses.en: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.
verses.sm: a ua ou filifilia Ierusalema ina ia i ai loʻu igoa; ua ou filifilia foi Tavita ina ia pule o ia i loʻu nuu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.sm: Sa loto foi loʻu tama o Tavita e fai se faie mo le suafa o le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu.

verses.en: But the LORD said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:
verses.sm: A ua fetalai mai le ALI i loʻu tamā o Tavita, Aua ua e loto ina fai se tale i lo'u igoa, ua lelei ina ua i ai i lou loto.

verses.en: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.
verses.sm: A e peitai oe, e te le faia le fale; a o lou atalii o lau lava fanau, o ia na te faia le fale i loʻu igoa.

verses.en: The LORD therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.sm: Io Ua faataunuuina foi e le ALn lana afioga na ia fetalaia mai; aua ua nofo atu aʻu e fai ma sui o loʻu tama o Tavita, ua ou tietie foi i le nofoalii o Isaraelu, e faapei ona fetalai mai ai o le ALII, ua ou faia foi le fale mo le suafa o le ALr le Atua o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, that he made with the children of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua ou tuuina ai foi le atolaau o loo i ai le feagaiga a le ALII, na osia e ia ma le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:
verses.sm: Ua tuo ia i luma o le fata faitaulaga o le Aw i luma o le faapotopotoga uma o Isaraelu, ma na faaloaloa ona lima;

verses.en: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,
verses.sm: aua na faia e Solomona le tulaga ‘apa memea e lima kupita lona umi, ma le lima o kupita lona lautele, ma le tolu o kupita lona maualuga, ma ua tuu ai i totonu o le lotoá; ua tu foi o ia i ona luga, ma ua tootuli i ona tulivae i luma o le faapotopotoga uma o Isaraelu, ma ua faaloaloa ae ona lima i le lagi.

verses.en: And said, O LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:
verses.sm: Ua faapea atu foi o ia, Le ALI e, le Atua o Isaraelu, e leai se Atua e tu3a ma oe i le lagi, po o le lalolagi; o loo tausia le feagaiga ma le alofa i au auauna, o e savavali i ou luma ma o latou loto atoa;

verses.en: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
verses.sm: o oe ua e tausia i lau auauna o Tavita loʻu tamā o le mea na e fetalai mai ai ia te ia; na e fetalai mai i lou fofoga, o lou aao foi ua e faataunuuina ai, e faapei ona fai i le aso nei.

verses.en: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, le Aw: e, le Atua o Isaraelu, ia e tausia mā lau auauna o Tavita lo'u tamā le mea na e fetalai mai ai ia te ia, ua faapea mai, E le aunoa se tagata ia te oe i ou luma e tietie i le nofoālii o Isaraelu; tau lava ina tausia e au fanau o latou ala, ina ia latou savavali i laʻu tulafono, e faapei ona e savali i oʻu luma.

verses.en: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.
verses.sm: O lenei, le ALI e, le Atua o Isaraelu, ia e faamaonia lau afioga na e fetalaia mai i lau auauna o Tavita.

verses.en: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!
verses.sm: Pe moni ea e afio le Atua ma tagata i le lalolagi? Faauta, o le lagi ma le lagi o lagi e le ofi ai oe; e le atili ai ea ona E le ofi i lenei fale ua ou faia?

verses.en: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:
verses.sm: A ia e liuliualo mai i le tatalo a lau auauna, ma lana aioj, le ALI e, loʻu Atua, ina ia faafofoga mai i le valaau ma le tatalo, o loo tatalo atu ai lau auauna i ou luma;

verses.en: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.
verses.sm: ina ia silasila mai ou fofoga i lenei fale i le ao atoa ma le po, o le mea na e fetalaia mai, e te tuu i ai lou suafa; ina ia e faafogafoga maii le tatalo e tatolo atu ai lau auauna i lenei mea.

verses.en: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.
verses.sm: la e faafofoga mai i le aioi atu a lau auauna, ma lou nuu o Isaraelu, pe a latou tatalo atu i lenei mea; ia e faafofoga mai foi mai le lagi, o le mea o loo e afio ai; ia e faafofoga mai, ma ia e faamagalo mai.

verses.en: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;
verses.sm: Afai e agasala se tasi tagata i le tasi tagata, ma ua fai atu o ia ia te ia na te faia se tautoga, ina ia tauto ai o ia, a oo mai foi le tautoga i luma o lou fata faitaulaga i lenei fale;

verses.en: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.
verses.sm: ia e faafofoga mai mai le lagi, ma ia e faia le faamasinoga i au auauna, e taui atu i le ua amioleaga, ia tauia lana amio ia te ia lava; e ta‘uamiotonuina foi le ua amiotonu, ia tuuina atu ia te ia e tusa ma lana amiotonu.

verses.en: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;
verses.sm: A fasia lou nuu o Isaraelu i luma o e ita mai, ina ua latou agasala atu ia te 0e; a latou toe foi mai, ma ta‘uta‘u atu lou suafa, ma tatalo, ma aioi atu i ou luma i lenei fale;

verses.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.
verses.sm: ia e faafofoga mai oe mai le lagi, ma e faamagalo mai le agasala a lou nuu o Isaraelu, ma e faafoisia mai i latou i le laueleele na e foaiina mai ia te i latou ma o latou tama.

verses.en: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;
verses.sm: A punitia le lagi, ma ua leai se ua, ina ua agasala atu i latou ia te oe; afai latou te tatalo i le mea nei ma latou ta‘uta‘u atu lou suafa, ma liliu ese i a latou agasala, pe a e faatiga ia te i latou;

verses.en: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.
verses.sm: ia e faafofoga mai oe i le lagi, ma e faamagalo mai le agasala a au auauna, ma lou nuu o Isaraelu, pe a aʻoaʻoina i latou e oe i le ala lelei latou te savavali ai; ma ia e foai mai le ua i luga o lou laueleele, na e foaiina mai i lou nuu e fai mo latou tofi.

verses.en: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:
verses.sm: Afai e i ai i le nuu se oge, afai e i ai se faamai, afai e i ai le mamae, po o le polopologa, o le sé akerise, po o le anufe; a e afai e siosioina i latou i le nuu o i ai a latou aai e i latou o e ita mai; so o se mala, po o se maʻi e i ai;

verses.en: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:
verses.sm: o talosaga uma ma aioi uma e fai e se tasi tagata, po o lou nuu o Isaraelu uma, o e ua iloa taitoatasi o lona maʻi, ma lona tiga, ma faaloaloa ona lima i lenei fale;

verses.en: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)
verses.sm: ia e faafofoga mai mai le lagi, o le mea o loo e afio ai, ma e faamagalo mai, ma e taui atu i tagata taitoatasi e tuza ma ana amio uma, ua e silafia lona loto; auā na o oe lava e silafia loto o tagata;

verses.en: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
verses.sm: ina ia latou matatau ia te oe, ma savavali i ou ala, i aso uma latou te ola ai i le laueleele na e foaiina mai i o matou tamā.

verses.en: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;
verses.sm: O le tagata ese foi, e le so lou nuu o Isaraelu, a ua sau o ia mai le nuu mamao, ona o lou suafa mamalu, ma lou aao malosi, ma lou aao faaloaloa; afai latou te o mai, ma tatalo i lenei fale;

verses.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as doth thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.
verses.sm: ia e faafofoga mai mai le lagi, o le mea o loo e auo ai, ma e faia e tusa ma mea uma e valaau atu ai le tagata ese ia te oe; ina ia iloa lou suafa e nuu uma i le lalolagi, ma ia latou matatau ia te oe, E faapei o lou nuu o Isaraelu; ia latou iloa foi ua igoa i lou suafa lenei fale ua ou faia.

verses.en: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;
verses.sm: Afai e o atu lou nuu e tau le taua ma E ita mai ia te i latou i le ala e te aauina atu ai i latou, ma latou tatalo atu ia te oe o faasaga mai i lenei aai na e filifilia, ma le fale ua ou faia mo lou suafa;

verses.en: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.sm: ia e faafofoga mai mai le lagi i a latou tatalo, ma a latou aioi atu, ma ia e fai le faamasinoga mo i latou.

verses.en: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;
verses.sm: Afai latou te agasala atu ia te oe, (auā e leai se tagata ua le agasala,) ma e toasa mai ia te i latou, ma e tuuina atu i latou i e ita mai ia te i latou, ma latou ave ia te i latou faatagataotaua i se nuu mamao, pe latalata mai;

verses.en: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;
verses.sm: a e afai e toe manatunatu ifo i latou i le nuu e avea i ai i latou faatagataotaua, ma latou liliu mai, ma aioi mai ia te oe i le nuu o latou o tāfea i ai, ma latou faapea atu, Ua agasala i matou, ma faapiopio i matou, ma amio leaga;

verses.en: If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:
verses.sm: afai latou te liliu mai ia te oe ma o latou loto atoa, ma o latou agaga atoa, i le nuu o latou o tāfea i ai, e ave i latou i ai faatagataotaua, ma latou tatalo e faasaga mai i lo latou nuu na e foaiina mai i o latou tamā, ma le aai na e filifilia, ma le fale ua ou faia mo lou suafa;

verses.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.
verses.sm: ia e faafofoga mai mai le lagi, o le mea o loo e afio ai i a latou tatalo, ma a latou aioi atu, ma ia e fai le faamasinoga mo i latou, ma e faamagalo mai i lou nuu o E ua agasala atu ia te oe.

verses.en: Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and let thine ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
verses.sm: O lenei, loʻu Atua e, ou te aioi atu, ia silasila mai ou fofoga, ma ia e liliu mai ou fofoga i le tatalo e faia i lenei mea.

verses.en: Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.
verses.sm: O lenei, le ALII e, le Atua, ia e tulai atu i lou malologa, o oe ma le atolaau o lou malosi; le ALII e, le Atua, ia oofu au ositaulaga i le olataga, ia fiafia au pele i le lelei.

verses.en: O LORD God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.
verses.sm: Le ALII e, le Atua, aua neʻi e “alo ou fofoga i le na e faauuina; ia e manatua ou alofa i lau auauna o
